title: tremastelma brachiata
intro: Tremastelma brachiata, commonly known as the "Indian Caltrops", is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and various skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Tremastelma brachiata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
